_comment: Optional per-agent model overrides for the dev-workflow feature loop. Copy to .dev-workflow/models.json and edit. Any agent you OMIT keeps the default baked into its agents/*.md frontmatter. Values accept aliases (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable) which track the newest model of that family, or a full model ID (e.g. claude-opus-5-5) to pin a version, plus 'inherit' (use the session's main model). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
